target.title: [codex] Add outbound payload decoration hook
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Plugins can observe broad outbound text via `message_sending`, but they cannot append portable presentation controls on the shared outbound path. `reply_payload_sending` is payload-capable, but too narrow for message-tool/source/proactive paths. This blocks generic plugin-owned outbound UI without adding channel-specific fields.

## What Changed

- Adds a generic `outbound_payload_decorating` hook.
- Keeps the hook append-only: no cancel, no text rewrite, no payload replacement.
- Lets decorators append portable `MessagePresentation` blocks before channel rendering.
- Preserves hidden outbound metadata across payload clone/normalization boundaries.
- Keeps `message_sending` text-only and `reply_payload_sending` unchanged.
- Suppresses decorator additions when existing interactive/presentation controls should win.
- Exports the hook types through the plugin SDK.
- Documents the hook in `docs/plugins/hooks.md` and `docs/plugins/message-presentation.md`.

This is a minimal generic carry+consume seam for plugin-owned outbound presentation. It does not add prompt/model generation, Telegram-native markup, telemetry, schema changes, or feature-specific behavior.

## Evidence

Local focused proof:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/wired-hooks-outbound-payload-decorating.test.ts src/infra/outbound/deliver.test.ts`
  - 2 shards passed
  - `src/infra/outbound/deliver.test.ts`: 102 tests passed
  - `src/plugins/wired-hooks-outbound-payload-decorating.test.ts`: 3 tests passed
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check docs/plugins/hooks.md docs/plugins/message-presentation.md src/auto-reply/reply-payload.ts src/infra/outbound/deliver.test.ts src/infra/outbound/deliver.ts src/infra/outbound/payloads.ts src/plugin-sdk/core.ts src/plugins/hook-types.ts src/plugins/hooks.ts src/plugins/wired-hooks-outbound-payload-decorating.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

Additional validation from the implementation worktree before salvage:

- `pnpm tsgo:core`
- `pnpm tsgo:core:test`
- Docs checks passed
- Autoreview reported one P3 around metadata preservation; fixed with an explicit regression assertion before this PR branch was created.

Remote proof note: delegated Blacksmith/Testbox and AWS Crabbox were attempted during implementation, but this checkout lacked the required local auth (`blacksmith auth login` / Crabbox broker login). The PR therefore includes focused local proof and documents the remote-auth blocker rather than pretending remote proof ran.

Docs: https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks and https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/message-presentation
